Name: Kenneth's Anniversary Gift
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Another year has passed in the valley, and it's time to celebrate![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Anniversary Gift is a small, heartfelt mod that gives you a special anniversary present every Spring 1 starting from Year 2. It's designed to feel like the valley thanking you for staying.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Designed to be sentimental but practical - everything is either edible, openable, or stackable.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What's inside (yearly):[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 5x Pink Cake, 5x Chocolate Cake, 10x Cookies - anniversary celebration treats[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 2x Magic Rock Candy - a rare special treat[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 5x Diamond, 3x Stardrop Tea, 5x Golden Mystery Box, 2x Prismatic Shard - sentimental valuables[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 20,000g anniversary bonus[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All items are consumable, openable, or stackable in one chest. Perfect even in Year 20 - cakes get eaten, boxes get opened, tea gets gifted, and gems stack neatly.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Details:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Arrives Spring 1 yearly from Year 2 onwards via mail[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Works alongside my Kenneth's New Year's Gift mod[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Balanced and vanilla-friendly[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Super Lightweight - only Content Patcher, no extra dependencies, no performance impact[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Lore-friendly letter and cozy vibe[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Thank you for staying in Pelican Town. Here's to another year![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility: All of my yearly mail gift mods are on separate mod pages but they work perfectly together with no conflicts and no overwrites. You can install just one or all of them if you want to experience celebrations throughout the whole year - your choice! Full list:[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Christmas Gift[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's New Year's Gift[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Valentine's Gift[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Feast of Winter Star Secret Gift[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Easter Egg Hunt[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Summer Beach Party Gift[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Birthday Treat[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Harvest Gift[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Halloween Trick or Treat[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Anniversary Gift[/b][/size]

Manifest.Name: Kenneth's Anniversary Gift
Manifest.Description: Happy Anniversary! Celebrate every year you stay in the valley with cakes, diamonds and surprises - sentimental treats every Spring 1 from Year 2 onwards. No clutter, just celebration! Yearly.
Manifest.Author: KennethFiel
